messages:
anya (sec): Quick sync: we want to drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN/CAP_NET_ADMIN/CAP_NET_RAW and remove common setuid bits from our base images. Need discovery, KMS signing/IAM, audit config, admission gating, and rollback plan. Short answers pls.
sam (infra): I'll run discovery. Two quick probes: pods with securityContext.capabilities.add and a suid file scan via a privileged DaemonSet in staging. Will report owners with matches.
li (eng-runtime): Kubectl tips: `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name} {.spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add}
{end}' | grep -v "<none>"`. For initContainers mirror .spec.initContainers.
rm (platform): Signing: recommend per-team KMS keys, grant build SA only cryptoKeySign, use Workload Identity, and enable DATA_ACCESS audit logs (they're off by default). I'll draft TF module and IAM snippet.
anya (sec): Agree per-team keys. Add key-rotation policy: quarterly or after major rebase; require automated re-sign job and structured signing logs (image,digest,builder_sa).
sam (infra): Note: will verify Data Access logs and enable for new keys. Inventory ETA: EOD.
li (eng-runtime): Rollout proposal: 1) inventory + notify owners 2) Gatekeeper audit-mode (2w) 3) rebuild + sign per-team images, push to canary namespaces 4) switch to deny w/ escape namespace & rollback playbook.
rm (platform): I'll include logging sink to SIEM in TF PR and an example cosign invocation using KMS via Workload Identity.
builder-bot: Scheduled rebuild job queued for 2024-11-06T03:00:00Z.
anya (sec): Action items: sam: inventory; rm: TF PR; li: gatekeeper audit policy + resign script; I'll own enforcement decision and incident playbook. Tagging ticket SEC-1100. :thumbsup:
